suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as post traumatic epilepsy risk. Require documented focal cerebral injury/contusion or diffuse cerebral injury consistent with the source and separately diagnosed post-traumatic epilepsy. Do not equate early provoked post-traumatic seizures with epilepsy. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation that cerebral contusion diffuse axonal injury matches the source-specific phenotype
Independent diagnosis of Epilepsy with compatible chronology
Assessment of competing medical, treatment-related, behavioral, and demographic contributors

Resolution of the publication guard: Require documented focal cerebral injury/contusion or diffuse cerebral injury consistent with the source and separately diagnosed post-traumatic epilepsy. Do not equate early provoked post-traumatic seizures with epilepsy.
